notes: Phase 0B delta proposal: operations below are to be applied to a future versioned permissions registry after platform review. The production permissions-v1.json is NOT modified in this batch.
declarablePermissionIds additions make vocabulary writable into Manifest v2 sourceDeclaration; it never implies granted, enabled, or capability-supported.
Existing permissions keep their semantics; only publicApiTargets gain members scoped by already-authorized handles/targets (see docs/WEBWINDOWS_STORAGE_MEDIA_V1_DRAFT.md).

permission.description: Send a bounded scene text payload to DeskTalk AI via a Host-owned confirmation card and receive itemized text proposals through the ai.assist.received event. No file, no thread, no automatic sending.

operations.note: Chunk reads ride the existing resource-grant: the handle token must come from a prior user-authorized device.storage.openFile in the same session; no new file-access authority.
Write-session begin stays host-owned-user-action; the target is resolved by the trusted save dialog before begin returns.
Chunk/commit/abort ride the session bound to the user-authorized write target; sequential-cursor only.

operations.rationale: com.aryansoft.deskshadow's planned Manifest v2 permission set: cloud project files (G8 decision: cloud-side project JSON, media reimport mode) plus desk-scoped file pick for source media and ai.desktalk-assist for L2 orchestration. Keeping device.storage-directory.* in the declarable-add list remains optional and may be dropped by review to minimize scope.

validationChecks: No operation introduces a permission id absent from the operations themselves and the base registry.
declarablePermissionIds remains a closed list (no wildcards).

Every new publicApiTargets member exists in one of the two methods-draft JSONs of this batch (capability-broker-media-methods-draft-v0.json / capability-broker-ai-methods-draft-v0.json), so registry and vocabulary deltas land as one consistent batch.
